##### Project general facts

Muheira Maysan is a residential masterpiece, comprising two elegantly designed towers that rise from a ground-floor, podium configuration, blending seamlessly into the dynamic urban landscape. This exceptional complex boasts an array of modern one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, meticulously laid out to provide spacious living areas, high-quality finishes, and a harmonious environment that effortlessly caters to the diverse needs of families, couples, and young professionals. The thoughtful design of Muheira Maysan combines the perfect blend of centrality and seclusion, with lavishly appointed homes surrounded by lush, serene parks that invite relaxation and recreation.

The residences at Muheira Maysan are supported by an impressive array of resort-style amenities, carefully crafted to provide the ultimate in comfort and leisure. The podium level is home to an adult pool and a shaded children's pool, while the sky level boasts an outdoor pool and a sprawling terrace that offers breathtaking, panoramic views of the surrounding cityscape. Additional amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, a serene yoga studio, children's play areas, a cozy reading room, barbecue areas, a rooftop garden, a cinema, and expansive leisure areas, all of which come together to create a vibrant, family-friendly lifestyle that seamlessly blends relaxation, fitness, and social interaction. The canal promenade, featuring jogging tracks and cycling paths, adds a unique dimension to the community experience, fostering a sense of connection and camaraderie among residents.

Every residence at Muheira Maysan features exquisite, modern finishing with high-quality materials, fully equipped kitchens, and thoughtful, functional layouts that maximize space and promote a sense of well-being. Expansive windows and balconies provide an abundance of natural light, framing stunning, open city views and creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection that invites residents to soak in the beauty of their surroundings. The strategic placement of windows ensures privacy and optimizes shade to reduce heat gain, while the interiors blend spacious, elegant design with luxurious, hospitality-inspired finishes, resulting in homes that embody comfort, refinement, and contemporary sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Reem Island is a thriving, mixed-use community that offers a unique blend of resort-style living and urban convenience, with Muheira Maysan nestled at its heart. This exceptional location is distinguished by its proximity to the sea and beaches, providing a vibrant, dynamic living environment that is infused with the sights, sounds, and smells of the ocean. The area is characterized by an abundance of parks and sports areas, creating a lively, energetic atmosphere that is perfect for families, couples, and young professionals who crave an active, outdoor lifestyle.

The social and entertainment infrastructure on Al Reem Island is remarkably well-developed, with a wide range of banks, commercial facilities, and amenities readily available to residents. As one of the first freehold zones in Abu Dhabi, Al Reem Island has attracted significant investment, resulting in a vibrant, cosmopolitan community that is connected to the heart of the city. Major landmarks such as ADGM, The Galleria Mall, Downtown Abu Dhabi, Louvre Abu Dhabi, New York University, and Zayed International Airport are all within easy reach, making Al Reem Island an ideal location for those who seek a balanced, refined lifestyle that combines the best of city living with the tranquility of a resort-style community.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the essence of modern living, community connection, and a prime Abu Dhabi location, Al Reem Island delivers an unparalleled lifestyle that is both vibrant and refined. The island's unique combination of waterfront living, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the emirate's most desirable destinations, attracting individuals and families who crave a sophisticated, urban lifestyle that is infused with the beauty and tranquility of the ocean. As a place to live, work, and play, Al Reem Island is a truly exceptional location that offers the perfect blend of relaxation, recreation, and refinement, making it an ideal choice for those who seek a truly elevated living experience.
